question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate set of words to complete the sentence.**

While teaching my son how to drive a car, I told him if he didn’t hit the ______ in time he would ______ the car’s side mirror.
solution:
The correct answer is** "brake; break."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The first blank needs a word which can be used for stopping the car.
 
• **"Brake"** refers the part of a vehicle that makes it go slower or stop. (वाहन की गति को मंद करने या रोकने वाला उपकरण; ब्रेक)
 
 
• **Example**: <em&g
